post_matric_scholarship.name: Central Sector Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
required_documents: Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar / SDM
Aadhaar card linked with bank account (DBT)

pm_kisan.name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi Scheme
required_documents: Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar

pm_awas_yojana.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY - Housing for All)
pm_awas_yojana.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Affidavit stating applicant does not own a pucca house in India
Land / Property ownership documents (for Rural / Construction)

bocw_welfare.name: Building & Other Construction Workers (BOCW) Welfare Scheme
bocw_welfare.ministry: Ministry of Labour & Employment / State Labour Board
required_documents: BOCW Worker Registration Card (90 days work certificate)
